title: Flaky: VS Code extension Blazor browser debugger E2E tests fail with websocket proxy launch failure and WASM root session timeouts on Linux
test_name: Aspire Blazor browser debugger E2E hits a managed breakpoint for hosted-global / hosted-per-page
job_name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Linux, browser-debugger)
error_pattern: Error: Timed out after ~299600ms waiting for Blazor WASM root session for resource 'hosted-global'/'hosted-per-page'. Last error: <none>.
analysis: Both hosted-global and hosted-per-page Blazor WASM debugger E2E scenarios timed out after ~300 seconds waiting for the managed WASM debug root session to be established on Linux. This is a known recurring flaky pattern in the VS Code extension E2E browser-debugger suite unrelated to this PR, which only modifies Azure provisioning proxy generation code and has no relationship to the VS Code extension or its debugger infrastructure.
